title: RoseArt Kellogg's Cereal Favorites 1000 Piece Jigsaw Puzzle for Adults
writeup: This RoseArt 1000 piece jigsaw puzzle collects vintage Kellogg's cereal box art into one nostalgic collage, finished at roughly 19 by 27 inches with snap-fit pieces. It is priced at $5.49 new, about half of the $10.99 Walmart charges for the same model. A cheap, giftable puzzle night pick for cereal fans.
